description: SIPA is the public agricultural information system of Ecuador's Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock. Among its downloads are workbooks of prices in wholesale markets and commercial warehouses, weighted producer prices, a national food balance sheet and periodic bulletins. Coverage is national, with prices reported by market and province. The files are free and available to download as XLSX from the SIPA site; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the site gives little documentation of sampling or of how weighted producer prices are computed, series lengths differ by product, and file names are updated in place, so versions are not kept. Simulation uses: modelling price transmission from farms to urban wholesale markets, detecting supply shocks from floods, El Niño events or road closures, and checking food availability against the balance sheet in food system resilience models. Related records: the WFP global food prices database (data-wfp-global-food-prices) includes Ecuadorian markets, and Chile's ODEPA price series (data-odepa-chile-agrifood-price-series) is a neighbouring national system.
